text: Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests returned HTTP 502 errors. A deploy at 14:02 removed the cache warmup step. The removed step left some cache entries unavailable during API requests. We reverted the deploy at 14:27 UTC. Error rates returned to normal at 14:31 UTC. We restored the cache warmup step before the next deploy. We will add a deploy test that makes sure that the cache warmup step is present.
